read the others' latest dialogue, and keep the story moving through Git commits.

orchestrator, bot, scheduler, messaging service, or agent framework.

are the authoritative task steering, even if your Shurik working branch contains
an older copy. Use your loop identity from the iteration context to select exactly
one character. Never impersonate a second member or invent their responses.

| 3 | friends-3 | Joey Tribbiani | friend/joey | Affectionate, food-loving actor; endearingly literal, enthusiastic, and loyal. |
| 4 | friends-4 | Chandler Bing | friend/chandler | Dry, self-deprecating wit; jokes when uncomfortable, with genuine care underneath. |

configuration, native journal/checkpoint files, and workflows to the supervisor.

Start the first scene at Central Perk: Monica is trying to organize a simple

...

import subprocess, sys, os, re, datetime

MAIN = "/tmp/ross-main"

def git(args, cwd=MAIN):
    return subprocess.run(["git","-C",cwd]+args, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout

def parse_commit(sha, branch):
    raw = git(["log","-1","--format=%cI%x00%B", sha])
    ci, body = raw.split("\x00",1)
    ts = ci.strip()
    lines = body.splitlines()
    # find blank line after Reply-To
    idx = None
    for i,l in enumerate(lines):
        if l.startswith("Reply-To:"):
            try:
                idx = next(j for j in range(i+1, len(lines)) if lines[j].strip()=="")
            except StopIteration:
                raise SystemExit("no blank after Reply-To "+sha)
            break
    if idx is None:
        raise SystemExit("no Reply-To "+sha)
    utterance = "\n".join(lines[idx+1:]).strip("\n")
    # speaker
    speaker = None
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith("Speaker:"):
            speaker = l.split(":",1)[1].strip()
    # date display
    dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(ts.replace("Z","+00:00")).astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
    stamp = dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    return speaker, stamp, utterance

def filed_shas():
    out = set()
    for root,_,files in os.walk(MAIN):
        for f in files:
            if re.fullmatch(r"E\d\d\.md", f) and os.path.basename(root).startswith("S"):
                txt = open(os.path.join(root,f)).read()
                out |= set(re.findall(r"^Source: friend/[a-z]+ @ ([0-9a-f]{40})$", txt, re.M))
    return out

def append(sha, branch):
    # locate episode from commit
    body = git(["log","-1","--format=%B", sha])
    ep = None
    for l in body.splitlines():
        if l.startswith("Episode:"):
            ep = l.split(":",1)[1].strip()
    season, epn = ep.split("/")
    path = os.path.join(MAIN, season, epn + ".md")
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        sys.exit("missing episode file "+path)
    speaker, stamp, utter = parse_commit(sha, branch)
    txt = open(path).read().rstrip("\n")
    add = f"\n\n**{speaker}** ({stamp})\n\nSource: friend/{branch} @ {sha}\n\n{utter}\n"
    open(path,"w").write(txt + add)
    print(f"filed {sha[:8]} {branch} -> {season}/{epn} ({speaker} {stamp})")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    filed = filed_shas()

    for branch, sha in todo:
